text.title: Product Launch Worked Example
text.summary: End-to-end worked example showing inputs → procedure → output for a typical instance of Product Launch.

example.scenario: Solo SaaS launches a changelog bot to the indie-dev segment. One segment, one message: 'auto-generated changelogs from Git, $9/mo'. Four channels — Product Hunt, HN Show, an X thread, and an email blast to 450 subscribers — satisfying the three-channel floor. One named success metric: 25 paid signups in launch week. Runbook gives each channel a timestamp, an owner and its own reversal step. Result: 31 paid, so the +14d review reads scale rather than hold.
Solo dev launching a $19/mo SaaS plan to a 200-person warm list + Product Hunt; pre-launch gates pass; launch day hits 12 paid; +14d review extends to a cold-email segment.
